message_ids: Provisional semantic IDs; reconcile with the unified catalog before wiring call sites.

locales.en: {name} saved, but it did not answer
The endpoint and its key are stored. Its model list cannot be read until it responds, so there is nothing to choose from yet.
locales.zh-CN: 接口地址和密钥已保存。在接口响应前无法读取模型列表，因此暂时没有可选择的模型。
locales.zh-TW: 端點網址與金鑰已儲存。在端點回應前無法讀取模型清單，因此暫時沒有可選取的模型。

locales.en: Check the base URL, the API key, and whether a VPN or firewall is blocking this address. You can still add a model by name and use it once the endpoint responds.
locales.zh-CN: 请检查基础 URL、API 密钥，以及 VPN 或防火墙是否阻止了该地址。你仍可按名称添加模型，待接口恢复响应后使用。
locales.zh-TW: 請檢查基底 URL、API 金鑰，以及 VPN 或防火牆是否阻擋了此網址。你仍可依名稱新增模型，待端點恢復回應後使用。

messages.note: Render the provider-supplied reason separately and unchanged. Do not include it in a translation-key lookup or HTML string.

locales.en: For a model the endpoint does not list, such as a private or preview one. Type the id exactly as the provider gave it to you; nothing checks it against their catalog.
locales.zh-CN: 用于添加接口未列出的模型，例如私有模型或预览模型。请准确输入供应商提供的模型 ID；此处不会与供应商目录进行核对。
locales.zh-TW: 用於新增端點未列出的模型，例如私人模型或預覽模型。請確實輸入供應商提供的模型 ID；此處不會與供應商目錄進行比對。

locales.en: It joins the picker as {model}. A wrong id fails on its first request, and you can remove it here.
locales.zh-CN: 它将以 {model} 的名称出现在模型选择器中。ID 错误会导致首次请求失败，你可以在此移除该模型。
locales.zh-TW: 它將以 {model} 的名稱出現在模型選擇器中。ID 錯誤會導致首次請求失敗，你可以在此移除該模型。

messages.note: One complete sentence replaces the old prefix/id concatenation. Build the full provider/model ID once and interpolate it without translation.

locales.en: Model names keep their {prefix} prefix, so models you already added stay where they are.
locales.zh-CN: 模型名称将保留 {prefix} 前缀，已添加的模型不会改变。
locales.zh-TW: 模型名稱將保留 {prefix} 前綴，已新增的模型不會改變。

messages.note: prefix is the exact endpoint ID followed by /. Never translate it.

locales.en: Any OpenAI-compatible API. After saving, choose which of its models appear in the picker; each is named after this endpoint so it never clashes with another provider's.
locales.zh-CN: 支持任何兼容 OpenAI 的 API。保存后，可选择在模型选择器中显示哪些模型；模型名称将包含此接口的标识，避免与其他供应商的模型冲突。
locales.zh-TW: 支援任何相容於 OpenAI 的 API。儲存後，可選擇要在模型選擇器中顯示的模型；模型名稱會包含此端點的識別碼，避免與其他供應商的模型衝突。

messages.note: Protocol name and endpoint path intentionally unchanged. The submitted adapter ID must also remain unchanged.
Protocol name and endpoint path intentionally unchanged. The submitted adapter ID must also remain unchanged.

locales.en: Leave empty to keep the current key
locales.zh-TW: 留空以保留目前的金鑰

locales.zh-CN: 留空以继续不使用密钥
locales.zh-TW: 留空以繼續不使用金鑰

locales.en: Leave empty for a keyless local server
locales.zh-CN: 本地服务器无需密钥时可留空
locales.zh-TW: 本機伺服器不需要金鑰時可留空

locales.en: The key is sent once to the router over standard input and stored in its protected local credential file. It is never placed in logs or command arguments.
locales.zh-CN: 密钥会通过标准输入发送给路由器一次，并保存在受保护的本地凭据文件中，不会写入日志或命令行参数。
locales.zh-TW: 金鑰會透過標準輸入傳送給路由器一次，並儲存在受保護的本機憑證檔案中，不會寫入記錄或命令列參數。

locales.en: This removes the endpoint, its saved API key, and every model you added from it.
locales.zh-CN: 这将移除此接口、已保存的 API 密钥，以及从此接口添加的所有模型。
locales.zh-TW: 這將移除此端點、已儲存的 API 金鑰，以及從此端點新增的所有模型。

messages.note: Use a separate translated label, not a partially translated raw endpoint-description string.
Whole singular/plural messages replace word-level concatenation.
cacheTelemetrySeen=false is absent telemetry, not a numerical 0%. Do not change the calculation.
percent is an already formatted percentage. Use the selected locale formatter; do not add a second percent sign.
The quota calculation and reset timestamp belong to #836 and are not imported by this draft.

locales.zh-CN: 已列出的路由与供应商目录一致
locales.zh-TW: 已列出的路由與供應商目錄一致

locales.zh-CN: 供应商目录已不再列出 {count} 个路由：{routes}
locales.zh-TW: 供應商目錄已不再列出 {count} 個路由：{routes}

messages.note: routes is the unchanged list of routed IDs and providers. Translate the known template only.

locales.en: all listed routes are advertised by their providers
locales.zh-CN: 供应商目录包含所有已列出的路由
locales.zh-TW: 供應商目錄包含所有已列出的路由

locales.en: The provider withdrew the model; remove or replace the route, then refresh the catalog.
locales.zh-CN: 供应商已下架该模型；请移除或替换对应路由，然后刷新目录。
locales.zh-TW: 供應商已下架此模型；請移除或替換對應路由，然後重新整理目錄。
